params.name: jurisdiction
params.description: Filter by jurisdiction code such as US, US-CA, GB, or EU.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by legislation status such as introduced, passed, enacted, or vetoed.

params.name: q
params.description: Full-text search query to filter results.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order for results. Use field name with optional - prefix for descending order.

params.name: updatedSince
params.description: Return only records updated after this ISO 8601 datetime.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of legislation records matching the specified filter criteria. Results include bills, resolutions, and other legislative measures from federal, state, and international jurisdictions.

params.name: legislationId
params.description: The unique identifier of the legislation.

items.docs: Returns detailed information about a specific piece of legislation including its full text, sponsors, co-sponsors, committee assignments, vote history, and current status.
